critical_code_review_comments: DriverProfile Pydantic model uses Field(min_length=1) + EmailStr for dispatcher_email — strict validation confirmed.

SendTripEmailRequest correctly enforces EmailStr on recipient, max_length=4 on attachments, non-empty subject/html_body. 503 path short-circuits BEFORE calling Resend SDK — clean behavior with empty RESEND_API_KEY.
Resend import happens unconditionally at top of server.py; resend.api_key only set when key is truthy — safe.

FinishExportDialog correctly builds JPEG + PDF blobs, base64-encodes, posts to /api/email/send-trip-sheet; on email failure it still calls /trip-sessions/{id}/finish and reloads — matches spec ('downloads/finish still proceed').
Toast for 503 may be truncated visually because the code reloads the page ~400 ms after finish; users still see the error toast momentarily before reload. Acceptable — trip is persisted finished.

All six target dialogs (profile-dialog, session-wizard, finish-dialog, continue-dialog, paper preview dialog, history view dialog) now expose DialogTitle + DialogDescription (visible or sr-only) — Radix warnings silenced in console (verified live).
profile-dispatcher input strips empty string before POST (delete payload.dispatcher_email when falsy) — matches backend EmailStr which rejects empty string.
